result.note: Mostly a political appeal; one question on what the May 2026 conservation appeal asked for and the unchanged retail fuel prices.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, amid the West Asia crisis, Prime Minister Narendra Modi made an appeal to conserve foreign exchange and fuel. Consider the following statements:
items: He asked Indians to stop buying gold for a year and to postpone foreign travel.
He urged farmers to halve chemical fertiliser use and move to solar-powered irrigation.
State-owned Oil Marketing Companies had raised retail petrol and diesel prices to offset their under-recoveries.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because retail petrol and diesel prices remained unchanged. Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum and Hindustan Petroleum were instead absorbing under-recoveries of INR 1,600–1,700 crore a day as crude rose from USD 70 to over USD 120 per barrel.
questions.source: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday asked Indians to stop buying gold for a year, cut fuel consumption, and postpone foreign travel to conserve foreign exchange amid the West Asia crisis.
